description: A cavernous hall of throbbing turbines and grimy conduit. The city plant squats at the centre, roaring, its casing scabbed with warning decals and oil. The whole room shudders with the low churn of megawatts.

window.description: A window set too high in the wall to see the ground through, so it offers the sky and nothing else. On a bad day that is more information than you want.
window.name: the high window

work_venue.clock_in_line: $HANDLE pulls a stool up to the spare bench and starts working the ticket pile.

name: Brownout Municipal — Turbine Hall
